camping.basic: Included for free with any 3-day or 5-day pass. Pitch your tent in designated 'free' zones.
camping.deposit: €30 'Leave-no-tent' deposit (refundable if you take your tent with you).

shuttleBoat.route: Jászai Mari Square (Dock 10) to Sziget Dock

publicTransport.train: H5 HÉV to Filatorigát (24/7 service during festival)
publicTransport.cityPass: Sziget-Budapest Citypass covers all public transport, shuttle boat, and airport transfers.

pricing.dailyBudget: Plan for €35 – €55 per day for food and drinks.

safety.medical: Main HQ near K-Bridge (Main Entrance), open 24/7.
safety.payments: 100% Cashless. Use contactless card, phone, or wristband.
safety.grocery: Aldi supermarket on-site for cheap groceries. Auchan (10 min walk from K-Bridge) for bulk buys.
